candidates = grasp_candidates("teal")

# Looking at the trace: edge pinch was passed directly to grasp() which only descends vertically.
# "grasp() cannot execute a side grasp: it always comes from above."

pinch_cands = [c for c in candidates if c.get("pinch", False)]

    cand = pinch_cands[0]
    app = cand["approach"]
    f_ax = cand["finger_axis"]
    gx, gy, gz = cand["x"], cand["y"], obs["table_z"] + cand["height"]

    # Pre-grasp: back along approach by 0.06m
